sources.snippet: TimesFM 3.0 is out! TimesFM 3.0 introduces native multivariate time-series forecasting, flexible covariate support (both past-only and past-and-future covariates), superior zero-shot generalist capabilities, and top performance across all three major time-series foundation model benchmarks.

sources.snippet: TimesFM 3.0 (PyTorch) TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting. This repository contains the official PyTorch weights and configurations for TimesFM 3.0.
